connector.name: Datalastic Vessel Tracking & Maritime Intelligence
connector.registryDescription: Vessel tracking for 750,000+ ships, with ownership, inspections, port records, routes, and more.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.datalastic.com over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.datalastic. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
